excerpt.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，[From.GetName]战争就发生了。
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

texts.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，[From.GetName]战争就发生了。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

texts.zh: 一支舰队在任务中失踪，他们会在友军领地内重新集合。
texts.en: A fleet has gone Missing In Action so that it can regroup inside friendly territory.
